create_note: create a new note with a title, optional data, meta, and access control settings
search_notes: search notes by query string with filtering by user, view option, permission, and sort order
get_notes_by_user_id: get all notes owned by a specific user with optional permission and pagination
update_note_by_id: update a note's title, data, meta, or access control by its unique id
delete_note_by_id: delete a note from the database by its unique id
